items.title: Virginia Takes Aim at Off-Grid Natural Gas as Texas Halts Data Center Permits
items.summary: Texas Gov. Greg Abbott has halted state permits for data centers pending a grid audit, the latest in a wave of state-level blows to a buildout natural gas producers and pipelines are counting on for demand growth.

items.title: Texas Drives September Mexico Natural Gas Imports Toward Record
items.summary: Strong pipeline flows out of South and West Texas are driving Mexican imports of US natural gas to historic levels, capping a summer of near-record cross-border shipments and fresh infrastructure expansion into Mexico’s industrial heartland.

items.title: FortisBC Clears Environmental Hurdle for Tilbury LNG Expansion
items.summary: FortisBC has secured federal and provincial environmental approvals for its proposed Tilbury Phase 2 LNG expansion, passing a key regulatory hurdle as the utility advances additional storage and liquefaction capacity near Vancouver.

items.title: Early Fall Cold, Supply Dip Push Natural Gas Futures Into Rally Mode
items.summary: Natural gas futures pushed higher into midday Tuesday as Lower 48 production fell to its lowest level since early August and forecasts showed the season’s first meaningful heating demand taking shape.

items.title: EQT Expands LNG Reach With 10-Year Supply Deal in Lithuania
items.summary: Lithuanian state-owned energy company Ignitis has agreed to buy LNG from EQT for 10 years beginning in 2027.

items.title: Woodfibre LNG Feedgas Pipeline Clears Major Tunneling Milestone
items.summary: A key natural gas supply link for Woodfibre LNG has finished work on a complex construction stage, keeping work moving on infrastructure needed to support the British Columbia (BC) export project’s planned 2027 startup.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Steady as Power Burn Drops Below 40 Bcf/d
items.summary: Natural gas futures steadied early Tuesday as a dip in power burn and softer LNG exports squared off against a decline in production readings, a day after the prompt month erased last week’s gains.
